purpose: Convert DNA/RNA PDB or PDBx/mmCIF coordinates to core CIF with residue-aware nucleotide atom recognition and optional linear backbone traces. Export chain-aware O3-prime graphs as Systre CRYSTAL CGD and native ChimeraX marker/link views. Optionally stitch backbone nicks (NAtopo's P...O3' join rule) and chain ends whose bases pi-stack across chains and symmetry images, and write NAtopo's ASU quotient graphs at chain and residue resolution for covalent bonds and stitching. Optionally add a C1-prime base node per nucleotide, linked to its O3-prime node, and join base nodes of NAtopo significant hydrogen pairs (C1'-C1' base-pair links in any symmetry image).
standing_user_requirements: Installable after every substantial patch, not only at formal releases.
Maintain clear human-readable and machine-readable intent in the repository.
CGD export keeps chains separate by default; opt-in --stitch-nicks (NAtopo rule) and --stitch-terminal-stacks add joins and report every unstitched candidate.
Publish as an independent vecchioni-lab Git repository named TopoTrace.

2026-11-13: junction stitching removed completely. Stitch every pi stack between chain ends (any polarity 5'-3', 5'-5', 3'-3'; same-polarity noted) unless already backbone joined. Generate the ASU graphs of main_NAtopo.ipynb at chain and residue resolution, for covalent bonds and stitching only.

2026-11-17: increase the graph complexity to two node types. Keep the O3' backbone representation and its nick/stack stitching; add the C1' carbon as a base node linked to its own O3' node, and map base-base hydrogen interactions to C1'-C1' links taken from NAtopo's residue representation. Opt-in flag --base-pairs. Keep unpaired base nodes and flag them. Chain-end stacks stay on O3' nodes for now; record that choice.

input.model_selection: one-based file encounter order, default first

outputs.reference_policy: self-contained coordinates and edges; source SHA-256 and basename are provenance
outputs.pdb_precision: 0.001 A coordinates; 0.01 occupancy/B. Refuse field overflow.
outputs.cgd_receipt_schema: schemas/cgd-receipt.schema.json (unstitched, schema 1); schemas/cgd-receipt-2.schema.json (stitched, schema 2); schemas/cgd-receipt-3.schema.json (C1' base nodes and base pairs, schema 3)

explicit_all_atoms.behavior: same as no atom flags; all atoms in selected model, respecting an explicit --altloc

selection.no_atom_flags: all atoms; preserve explicit CONECT and unambiguous same-image struct_conn links; report unsupported image/unresolved mmCIF links
selection.residue_order: input file order; numbering and insertion codes are identities, not sorting keys
selection.missing_atom_policy: skip and bridge within existing segment
selection.alternate_locations: preserved in all-atom conversion; explicit choice required for selected trace

crystallography.coordinate_policy: fractionalize without wrapping, minimizing, or changing the lattice
crystallography.scale_policy: precise cell for conventional PDB-rounded matrices; retain full-precision native mmCIF matrices and nonzero shifts
crystallography.symmetry_policy: copy declared PDB/mmCIF fractional operations; otherwise retain symbol and report
crystallography.graph_policy: explicit endpoint links; no distance-based perception or chemical bond-order inference, except the opt-in nick and chain-end stack screens in topotrace-cgd

non_goals: hydrogen-bond backbone joins (hydrogen contacts only form opt-in C1'-C1' base-pair links)
donor/acceptor or D-H...A angle validation of base pairs

stitching, chain-end stack and ASU-graph regressions; installed --stitch-nicks/--stitch-terminal-stacks/--asu-graphs smoke checks; NAtopo quotient cross-validation

recognition.lookup: residue code -> canonical role -> actual observed atom name
recognition.source: NARestraints/restraints/data/Ligands.xlsx working snapshot; SHA-256 recorded in catalog
recognition.duplicate_policy: most distinct observed mapped names; retain unresolved ties
recognition.extra_sugar_atoms: recognized internally; no new CLI trace order

cgd_export.dialect: CRYSTAL block, named source node plus fractional neighbor-image coordinates
cgd_export.representation: One nucleotide is represented by one node at its observed O3-prime atom coordinate; with --base-pairs a second node at its observed C1-prime atom stands for the base. No base centroid or fitted pseudoatom.
cgd_export.coordinates: Fractional coordinates in the declared cell; retain negative and greater-than-one neighbor coordinates to identify the intended periodic image.
cgd_export.node_degree: Actual incident edge count; special positions rejected pending stabilizer-aware support.
cgd_export.graph: Explicit consecutive retained O3-prime nodes within each original segment. With --stitch-nicks, additional periodic edges for one-to-one backbone nick joins between segment termini, in any symmetry/lattice image. With --stitch-terminal-stacks, periodic edges for every pi stack between two chain ends not already backbone joined. With --base-pairs, each nucleotide with an O3' node also has a C1' node linked to it, and C1'-C1' periodic edges join NAtopo significant hydrogen pairs; chain-end stacks remain O3'-O3'.
stitching_scope: chain-end pi stacks, any polarity (implemented, opt-in)
NAtopo junction rule (removed 2026-11-13 at the user's request; never released)
C1'-C1' base pairs from NAtopo significant hydrogen pairs (implemented 2026-11-17, opt-in --base-pairs)
pending: Reviewed confirm/remove decisions for ambiguous nicks
cgd_export.existing_missing_atom_policy: Continue skipping missing selected O3-prime atoms and bridging within the original strand segment; no invented coordinates.
cgd_export.position_guard: Reject special positions and symmetry overlaps within a conservative 0.003 per conventional fractional coordinate, modulo translations.

views.symmetry: --crystal-cmm, intact conventional symmetry copies, separate models; nick joins and terminal stacks in their own models
views.asu_quotient: --asu-chain-html / --asu-residue-html: self-contained SVG/HTML of the folded ASU graphs (NAtopo layouts)

nick_stitching.rule_source: NAtopo nucleotide_interactions.find_backbone_join_candidates + prepare_nucleotides loose-end rules + build_atom_graph polymer links
nick_stitching.loose_P: P with own O5' and no inter-residue covalent neighbor
nick_stitching.loose_O3: O3' with own C3' and no inter-residue covalent neighbor
nick_stitching.existing_link: consecutive O3'-P 0.8-2.2 A within a segment, or explicit input link 0.8-2.3 A (mmCIF _struct_conn only with a covalent conn_type_id; untyped PDB CONECT)
nick_stitching.join: loose P...loose O3' < 3.5 A on a different chain copy (other segment or other image)
nick_stitching.o5_fallback: phosphate-less O5' (own C5') ... loose O3' < 6.0 A; reported only unless --include-o5-fallback
nick_stitching.image_search: exact: all conventional operations incl. centering, all lattice translations within the cutoff
nick_stitching.acceptance: stitch only one-to-one joins between segment 3-prime and 5-prime termini; otherwise report status
nick_stitching.edge_convention: source = 3-prime end node at stored position; target = 5-prime strand's first O3-prime node in image g=operation+n; reciprocal row uses g inverse
nick_stitching.natopo_cross_validation: identical candidate orbits, images and distances on 17 local nucleic-acid crystals (2026-11-11)

terminal_stack_stitching.chain_ends: first (5') and last (3') backbone-bearing residue of each segment with >= 2 such residues; single-residue segments counted only
terminal_stack_stitching.rule_source: pi-stack geometry of NAtopo find_pi_interactions + fit_base_planes; ring names from the packaged NARestraints catalog
terminal_stack_stitching.pi_stack: centroids < 5.5 A, normals within 30 deg, both separations 2.0-4.5 A, both lateral shifts <= 3.0 A
terminal_stack_stitching.acceptance: stitch every end-end stack in any image, any polarity, unless the ends share a verified same-image O3'-P link or a nick join stitched in this run
terminal_stack_stitching.edge_convention: 5'-3' stacks oriented 3' end (stored) -> 5' end (image g); each end mapped to its segment's outermost O3' node

asu_graphs.rule_source: NAtopo asu_quotient.py + residue_quotient.py (main_NAtopo.ipynb folded ASU views)
asu_graphs.edges: one per symmetry orbit and type, labelled with the partner copy's PDB op_klm code; operator numbers from the input file
asu_graphs.periodicity: voltage-graph cycle translations: rank, Hermite basis, interpenetrating copies
asu_graphs.natopo_cross_validation: identical covalent/backbone-join orbits, symmetry codes and periodicity (NAtopo's own periodicity()) on 17 local crystals (2026-11-13)
asu_graphs.png: optional extra topotrace[png] (matplotlib); export fails before writing if it is missing

cgd_export.native_audit: tools/check_stitched_cgd.py (+ tools/CheckCgd.java --stitched); CheckCgd default mode is the unstitched baseline

base_pairs.rule_source: NAtopo nucleotide_interactions.find_hydrogen_bond_candidates (active nucleotide_interactions.json: 4.0 A, 30 deg, interchain) + crystal_interactions deposited hydrog + structural_features.FeatureGraph significant pairs (>= 2 distinct atoms per base)
base_pairs.node_labels: S<segment>_B<k> is the C1' node of the residue whose O3' node is S<segment>_N<k>
base_pairs.unpaired: kept as degree-1 C1' nodes, flagged base_paired=false and listed in stitch_parameters.base_pairs.unpaired_base_nodes
base_pairs.terminal_stacks: remain on O3' nodes (recorded choice 2026-11-17; revisit once base nodes are used)
base_pairs.natopo_cross_validation: all 164 rows of NAtopo outputs/<id>/base_pairs.csv on 6 crystals match (residues, atom pairs, atoms per base, oriented op_(k,l,m)) (2026-11-17)
limits: geometric screen only: no donor/acceptor chemistry or D-H...A angle (as in NAtopo)
symmetry-image deposited hydrog annotations are not read
residues without C1' get no base node
